W: Sure. If you’d like, we can also leave it with a neighbor or put it by your door.
M: Hmm ... The parcel contains expensive electronics, so I’d rather wait until I can receive it in person.
W: No problem. Then we can deliver it first thing the next morning.
M: Oh, if it’s possible, just after lunch would be even better for me.
W: Certainly. I just need your phone number to give to the driver. He’ll phone you before he arrives.
M: Great. My number is 390-7731 (*three nine oh, double-seven three one*)
Q 7-9
W: Thabo and Michiko, I need help designing some pamphlets for our evening business courses. I’d like to have them ready before the end of April.
W: Sure. Should we take a look at the ones from last year or make them different?
M: You know, I think the pamphlets last year had too many details. People can get dates and times from the Web site.
W: I agree. Let’s focus on the skills that people will learn in each class.
M: OK. I’ll come up with a rough version of the text for the pamphlets by tomorrow and e-mail it to you. Then, next week we can start working on the design.
Q10-12
W: Hi Ken, hi Julio! How did the art gallery opening go last weekend? Was the client happy with the marketing materials?
M: Alfredo? He was very pleased. He said he thought the brochures we designed were one of the main reasons for such a great turnout. (doanh thu)
M: And it’s worth checking out the gallery when you have some time. I’m sure Alfredo would be happy to give you a tour.
M: Yes, the place is so bright and modern, with a fantastic collection of local works of art.
W: you know, I’m taking a vacation in that area in February, I’ll make a point of visiting him.
Q13-15
W: So this is the two-bedroom unit that you saw advertised on our Web site. What do you think?
M: I like these  big windows.
W: Mmm. They really brighten up the room.
M: But I see some paint chipping around this door frame.
W: Oh, the landlord is going to repaint the walls before a new tenant moves in. If you take the apartment, you can even choose what color you’d like.
M: Ah, that’s fine then. And this unit opens up next week?
W: That’s right. You could move in as early as Monday.
M: Yeah?
W: If you like it, you can have a contract ready to sign by this afternoon.
Q16-18
M: I can’t believe the Vancouver convention’s so soon!
W: I know. It should be great, with all those big-name speakers. Are we all set for transportation?
M: Uh – the plane tickets are already taken care of, and you arranged for the rental car while we’re there – right, Mike?
M: Uh-oh. I completely forgot to make the car reservation! I’ve been so busy getting my workshop materials ready!
M: All ...right... We’re only two days away from leaving – it might be hard to get a car now!
W: Let’s not stress out about it. I saw something about a bus service to and from the hotel. Let’s talk to the hotel receptionist and see.
Q19-21
W: Hello, may I speak to Min-Jae Park? It’s about the renovations to Comet Bank. He’s the architect, right?
W: Yes. But may I ask who’s calling?
W: This is Sheryl Reed, the project manager for the Comet Bank renovations. I’m missing the drawings with the measurements for the main entrance, and I’m ordering the doors today.
W: OK. I’ll put you through to Mr. Park. Please hold.
W: Thanks.
M: Hello? Ms. Reed?
W: Hello, Mr. Park. Could you possibly get me another blueprint? I can’t find the drawings for the front entrance.
M: Certainly, Ms. Reed. It’ll take some time to print the plan, though. If you come by my office around three oclock, I’ll have it ready for you by then.
Q 22-24
M: Hi, Ms. Nelson? It’s Kevin Fielder, from City Apartments Plus.
W: Oh, hi. Were you able to find out if the Hapdale Building has any units for rent?
M: Yes, that’s why I’m calling. The answer is “yes” but ...
W: Great!
M: ...There’s one thing. Some renovations are being done in the building’s lobby and fitness center, so I don’t know if you want to move in while the construction is underway. It should take about four months.
W: I see ...
M: But there are some similar vacant units in the Tilbury Building – just two blocks away. Why don’t you check out the video tour on their Web site, www.tilbury.com? If you see anything promising, we could show you a unit this week.
W: sure, I’ll do that. Thank you.
